reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for autonomous code generation and test-driven error repair using a capped Reflect-Assess-Learn-Plan-Handle loop, with sandbox-mediated test execution and lifecycle events.

summaries.zh: 这是一个接入 DeepSeek Harness 的自主代码生成与错误修复插件，通过带硬循环上限的 RALPH 状态机规划、修改代码并运行测试。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that uses a capped RALPH state machine to plan, generate or repair code, and run tests in an integrated execution loop.

capabilities: Generates and modifies code based on a task
Runs user-specified test shell commands through Harness subprocess and sandbox services
Uses an LLM for planning, reflection, learning, and code generation
Writes and cleans up files in per-execution temporary workspaces
Emits lifecycle events and exposes a callable execution service and tool
